sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 3.2.5 (pp.7-8): survey team could find no one who recognised the name Oblo; Mohammadou (p.c.) could gather no linguistic data in 1972 because the people no longer remembered the language; 'The only record of their language was a list of eight words collected by the German military officer Kurt Struempell in Garoua.. 1905-1907. This list is the sole foundation for Greenberg's classification of Oblo among the Adamawan languages.' Appendix A quotes ALCAM 1983 [394]: 'Le oblo ne nous est connue que par une liste de huit mots recueillies par E. Mohammadou'.
